entities.summary: Talaat Aghasibey oglu Khanlarov (Azerbaijani: Tələt Ağasıbəy oğlu Xanlarov; 1927–2004 was a Soviet-Azerbaijani architect, academician of the Academy of Sciences of Azerbaijan, Honored Architect of the Azerbaijan SSR, and Vice President of the International Academy of Architecture of the East.
